title: HP TET JBT · December 2020 (previous year questions)
description: Questions asked in the HP TET JBT exam of the November 2020 session (held 14 December 2020), with answers checked against a published solved paper and independently verified. Not the complete paper: garbled, outdated or doubtful questions were left out.

questions.text: IQ of an 8 year old student, whose Mental Age is 6 years, will be
questions.textHi: 8 वर्षीय विद्यार्थी, जिसको मानसिक आयु 6 वर्ष है, को बुद्धि-लब्धि होगी-
questions.explanation: IQ = (MA/CA) × 100 = (6/8) × 100 = 75. (Q1 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: The part of personality which develops last is
questions.textHi: सबसे अन्त में विकसित होने वाला व्यक्तित्व का भाग है-
questions.explanation: In Freud's structure of personality the super-ego (conscience) develops last, after the id and ego. (Q2 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: Stage during which psycho-sexual energy is directed towards developing peer group social relations is
questions.textHi: वह अवस्था जिसमें काम उर्जा साथी-समूह के साथ सामाजिक सम्बन्ध विकसित करने में निर्देशित होती है-
questions.explanation: In the latency stage (about 6 to 12 years) sexual energy is channelled into school work and same-sex peer relations. (Q3 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: Morality is decided on the basis of personal norms during the
questions.textHi: व्यक्तिगत मानकों के आधार पर नैतिकता निर्धारण किया जाता है-
questions.explanation: At Kohlberg's post-conventional level, morality is judged by self-chosen personal and universal principles. (Q4 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: The ability to produce diverse thoughts on a subject is
questions.textHi: एक विषय पर विविध बिचार उत्पन्न करने की क्षमता है-
questions.explanation: Creativity involves divergent thinking: producing many varied ideas on a topic. (Q5 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: Who gave the stimulus substitution theory of learning?
questions.textHi: अधिगम का उद्दीपन प्रतिस्थापन सिद्धान्त किसने दिया?
questions.explanation: Pavlov's classical conditioning is called stimulus substitution: the conditioned stimulus substitutes for the natural one. (Q6 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: Low IQ of children brought up in orphanages is mainly due to
questions.textHi: अनाथालयों में पलने वाले बालकों की कम बुद्धि-लब्धि का प्रमुख कारण है-
questions.explanation: Children in orphanages often lack stimulation and care; this deprived environment lowers measured IQ. (Q7 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: Erikson's developmental task for elementary school students is
questions.textHi: प्रारम्भिक विद्यार्थियों के लिए एरिक्सन का मुख्य विकासात्मक कार्य है-
questions.explanation: Erikson's school-age stage is industry vs inferiority, when children acquire knowledge and skills. (Q8 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: As a science, Educational Psychology emphasises
questions.textHi: एक विज्ञान के रूप में शिक्षा मनोविज्ञान बल देता है-
questions.explanation: As a science, educational psychology relies on objective measurement and observation. (Q9 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: The approximate percentage of the population having IQ above 130 is
questions.textHi: जनसंख्या में 130 से अधिक बुद्धि-लब्धि वाले व्यक्तियों का प्रतिशत (लगभग) होगा-
questions.explanation: IQ above 130 is two standard deviations above the mean; about 2.2% of people fall there. (Q10 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-1.html

questions.text: First stage of development is
questions.textHi: विकास की प्रथम अवस्था है-
questions.explanation: Development begins at conception, so the prenatal stage comes first. (Q11 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: Semantic Memory is mainly associated with
questions.textHi: अर्थगत स्मृति (सिमेंटिक मेमोरी) मुख्यतः सम्बंधित है-
questions.explanation: Semantic memory stores general knowledge and facts (meanings, concepts). (Q12 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: Concept of mental age was given by :
questions.textHi: मानसिक आयु का सम्प्रत्यय दिया गया है
questions.explanation: Alfred Binet introduced the concept of mental age in the Binet-Simon scale (1905/1908). (Q13 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: Multidimensional ability is :
questions.textHi: बहुआयामी योग्यता है-
questions.explanation: Intelligence is regarded as a multidimensional ability (Thurstone, Gardner, Guilford). (Q14 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: According to ........, the self is the central point of personality.
questions.textHi: ........ के अनुसार स्व (आत्म) व्यक्तित्व का केन्द्र बिन्दु है।
questions.explanation: Humanistic psychology (Carl Rogers) treats the self as the core of personality. (Q15 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: What types of tests are army alpha and army beta?
questions.textHi: आर्मी अल्फा और आर्मी बीटा किस प्रकार के परीक्षण हैं?
questions.explanation: Army Alpha (verbal) and Army Beta (non-verbal) were group intelligence tests used in World War I. (Q17 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: According to Freud the basic human motivation is :
questions.textHi: फ्रायड के अनुसार मूल मानव प्रेरणा है -
questions.explanation: Freud saw sex (Eros) and aggression (Thanatos) as the two basic human drives. (Q18 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: Most people with Down syndrome (formerly called "Mongolism") have ........ chromosomes instead of 46.
questions.textHi: डाउन सिंड्रोम (पहले "मंगोलिज़्म" कहा जाता था) वाले अधिकांश व्यक्तियों में 46 के स्थान पर ........ गुणसूत्र होते हैं।
questions.explanation: Down syndrome results from trisomy 21, giving 47 chromosomes instead of 46. (Q19 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-2.html

questions.text: Span of attention is ……………
questions.explanation: Attention span is limited: we can attend to only a few things at a time. (Q21 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Retrieval is the process involved in ……………..
questions.textHi: पुनःप्राप्ति (Retrieval) ........ में शामिल एक प्रक्रिया है।
questions.explanation: Memory involves encoding, storage and retrieval; retrieval is recalling stored information. (Q22 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: WISC is used to measure the intelligence of
questions.textHi: WISC द्वारा ............ बुद्धि का मापन किया जाता है।
questions.explanation: WISC is the Wechsler Intelligence Scale for Children. (Q23 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: ........ categorised the stages of personality development on the basis of the resolution of social conflicts.
questions.textHi: .................. ने सामाजिक संघर्ष के समाधन के आधार पर व्यक्तित्व विकास की अवस्थाओं का वर्गीकरण किया है।
questions.explanation: Erikson's eight psychosocial stages are each defined by a social conflict (crisis) to be resolved. (Q24 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: To select some information for processing and to relegate others to periphery is
questions.textHi: सूचना प्रक्रमण के लिए कुछ सूचनाओं को चयनित कर अन्य को परिधि में धकेलने की प्रक्रिया है-
questions.explanation: Attention selects some information for processing and pushes the rest to the periphery (margin) of consciousness. (Q25 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Who said, "The process of education is entirely at the mercy of psychology"?
questions.textHi: यह किसने कहा - "शिक्षा की प्रक्रिया पूर्णतया मनोविज्ञान की कृपा पर निर्भर है"?
questions.explanation: This statement is attributed to B.N. Jha. (Q26 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Area of physical development is
questions.textHi: शारीरिक विकास का क्षेत्र है-
questions.explanation: Physical development includes the nervous system, muscles and endocrine glands. (Q27 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Strong motivation is an effective factor of learning. Under it the child
questions.textHi: सशक्त अभिप्रेरणा सीखनें का प्रभावशाली घटक है। इसमें बालक
questions.explanation: A strongly motivated child learns quickly and effectively. (Q28 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Who said, "Social development means the attaining of maturity in social relationships"?
questions.textHi: यह किसने कहा - “सामाजिक विकास का अर्थ सामाजिक सम्बन्धों में परिपक्वता प्राप्त करना है”?
questions.explanation: Hurlock defined social development as the attaining of maturity in social relationships. (Q29 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Who propounded the Dalton method?
questions.textHi: डाल्टन पद्धति के प्रतिपादक कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Helen Parkhurst developed the Dalton Plan (Dalton, Massachusetts, 1920). (Q30 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-3.html

questions.text: Choose the correct plural: Calf
questions.explanation: Nouns ending in -f often change to -ves: calf → calves. (Q31 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct plural: Child
questions.explanation: Child → children (irregular plural). (Q32 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct plural: Man
questions.explanation: Man → men (irregular plural). (Q33 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct passive form: I know her.
questions.explanation: 'Know' takes 'to' in the passive: She is known to me. (Q34 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct passive form: I can do it.
options: It can be done by me.
questions.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle: It can be done by me. (Q35 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the correct passive form: Children are flying kites.
options: Kites are being flown by children.
questions.explanation: Present continuous passive: are being + past participle: Kites are being flown by children. (Q36 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Seema was absent ........ the class.
questions.explanation: We are 'absent from' a place. (Q37 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: My ........ brother is coming today.
questions.explanation: 'Elder' is used for family seniority (elder brother). (Q38 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Here is ........ egg.
questions.explanation: 'Egg' begins with a vowel sound, so it takes 'an'. (Q39 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Why are you so angry ........ me?
questions.explanation: We are angry 'with' a person and 'at' a thing. (Q40 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-4.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: BOLD
questions.explanation: Timid (shy, lacking courage) is the opposite of bold. (Q41 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: LOVE
questions.explanation: Hatred is the opposite of love. (Q42 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to: HOPE
questions.explanation: Despair is the complete loss of hope. (Q43 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the one word for: Words with the same meaning.
questions.explanation: Synonyms are words with the same or similar meaning. (Q44 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the one word for: Happening every year.
questions.explanation: Annual means happening once every year. (Q45 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the one word for: A small thin piece of potato.
questions.explanation: A chip is a small thin piece (as in potato chips). (Q47 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct feminine form: Sir
questions.explanation: The feminine of Sir is Madam. (Q48 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct feminine form: Lord
questions.explanation: The feminine of Lord is Lady. (Q49 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correct feminine form: Duke
questions.explanation: The feminine of Duke is Duchess. (Q50 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-5.html

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word. (i)
questions.explanation: 'Elephant' is the correct spelling. (Q52 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word. (ii)
questions.explanation: 'Weather' is the correct spelling. (Q53 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to: RARE
questions.explanation: Rare means uncommon. (Q54 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to: MEETING
questions.explanation: A meeting can be called a conference, an assembly or a gathering. (Q55 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to: HANDSOME
questions.explanation: Handsome means good-looking. (Q56 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Choose the right word to complete the idiom: A white ........
questions.explanation: A white elephant is a costly possession that is of little use. (Q57 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Complete the proverb: Money makes the mare ........
questions.explanation: The proverb is "Money makes the mare go". (Q59 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: Complete the proverb: Much cry and little ........
questions.explanation: The proverb is "Much cry and little wool": a lot of fuss with little result. (Q60 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-6.html

questions.text: उत्थान शब्द में कौन सा उपसर्ग प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.explanation: उत्थान = उत् + स्थान; उपसर्ग "उत्" है। (Q61 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: 'धीरे-धीरे चलो नहीं तो थक जाओगे।' वाक्य में कौन-सा अव्यय प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.explanation: 'धीरे-धीरे' क्रिया के होने की रीति बताता है, अतः रीतिवाचक क्रियाविशेषण है। (Q62 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: सरल, पीला, घरेलू, बीमार, मीठा शब्द कौन से विशेषण के अंतर्गत आते हैं?
questions.explanation: ये शब्द संज्ञा के गुण, रंग, दशा, स्वाद बताते हैं, अतः गुणवाचक विशेषण हैं। (Q63 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: नम: + ते = नमस्ते शब्द में कौन सी संधि है?
questions.explanation: नमः + ते = नमस्ते; विसर्ग का स् में बदलना विसर्ग संधि है। (Q64 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: निज की भाववाचक संज्ञा है :-
questions.explanation: 'निज' की भाववाचक संज्ञा 'निजत्व' है। (Q65 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: वह कौन-सा वाचन है जो गद्य में तो प्रयुक्त होता है परन्तु पद्य में नहीं?
questions.explanation: मौन वाचन गद्य के लिए उपयुक्त है; कविता लय और भाव के कारण सस्वर पढ़ी जाती है। (Q66 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: ड़, ढ़ व्यंजन हैं:
questions.explanation: ड़ और ढ़ उत्क्षिप्त (द्विगुण/ताड़नजात) व्यंजन हैं, जिनमें जीभ ऊपर उठकर झटके से नीचे गिरती है। (Q67 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: तुलसीदास द्वारा रचित "रामचरितमानस" को किस भाषा में लिखा गया?
questions.explanation: तुलसीदास ने रामचरितमानस अवधी भाषा में लिखा। (Q68 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: 'नीलकंठ' शब्द में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: नीलकंठ = नीला है कंठ जिसका अर्थात् शिव; अन्य पद प्रधान होने से बहुव्रीहि समास। (Q69 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: किस विधि में पहले उदाहरण और बाद में परिभाषा दी जाती है?
questions.explanation: आगमन विधि में पहले उदाहरण दिए जाते हैं और उनसे नियम/परिभाषा निकाली जाती है। (Q70 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-7.html

questions.text: 'गुरु जी ने कहा कि कल छुट्टी रहेगी' वाक्य है:
questions.explanation: प्रधान उपवाक्य के साथ 'कि' से जुड़ा आश्रित उपवाक्य होने से यह मिश्र वाक्य है। (Q73 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द 'आत्मा' का पर्यायवाची नहीं है?
questions.explanation: 'वैभव' का अर्थ धन-संपत्ति है; चैतन्य, ब्रह्म, विभु आत्मा के पर्याय हैं। (Q74 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'जिसकी लाठी उसकी भैंस' वाक्य में कौन-सा सर्वनाम प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.explanation: 'जिसकी...उसकी' दो उपवाक्यों का संबंध जोड़ते हैं, अतः संबंधवाचक सर्वनाम। (Q75 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'हे भगवान! रक्षा करो।' वाक्य में कौन-सा कारक प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.explanation: 'हे भगवान!' में किसी को पुकारा गया है, अतः संबोधन कारक। (Q78 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'हिन्दी की चिन्दी निकालना' मुहावरे का अर्थ है:
options: किसी बात की तह तक पहुँचना
questions.explanation: इस मुहावरे का अर्थ है किसी बात की बारीकी से छानबीन करना, उसकी तह तक पहुँचना। (Q79 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'आप चाय पिएँगे या कॉफी?' वाक्य है:
questions.explanation: 'या' समानाधिकरण योजक से दो स्वतंत्र उपवाक्य जुड़े हैं, अतः संयुक्त वाक्य। (Q80 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-paper-part-8.html

questions.text: 'लड़कियाँ शतरंज का खेल देख रही हैं।' वाक्य में क्रिया 'देख रही हैं' का भेद है:
questions.explanation: 'देखना' क्रिया का कर्म 'खेल' है, अतः सकर्मक क्रिया। (Q81 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: 'बंदउँ गुरु पद पदुम परागा। सुरुचि सुबास सरस अनुरागा॥' उपर्युक्त पंक्तियों में कौन-सा छन्द प्रयुक्त हुआ है?
questions.explanation: रामचरितमानस की यह अर्धाली चौपाई छंद (16-16 मात्राएँ) में है। (Q82 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'अमृत के समान वचन'
questions.explanation: अमृत के समान वचन = वचनामृत। (Q83 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा विराम चिह्न उद्धरण चिह्न है?
questions.explanation: उद्धरण चिह्न " " किसी के कथन को ज्यों का त्यों लिखने में प्रयुक्त होता है। (Q84 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: 'काली घटा का घमंड घटा' पंक्ति में कौन-सा अलंकार है?
questions.explanation: 'घटा' शब्द दो बार भिन्न अर्थों (बादल, कम होना) में आया है, अतः यमक अलंकार। (Q85 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: 'कविता हमारे परिपूर्ण क्षणों की वाणी है।' यह किसका कथन है?
questions.explanation: यह परिभाषा सुमित्रानंदन पंत की मानी जाती है। (Q86 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: 'वह पढ़ता तो पास हो जाता।' वाक्य में कौन-सा काल है?
questions.explanation: एक क्रिया का होना दूसरी पर निर्भर हो और दोनों भूतकाल में न हुई हों तो हेतुहेतुमद् भूत होता है। (Q87 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: 'अंदर छूत नहीं, बाहर दूर-दूर' लोकोक्ति का अर्थ है:
questions.explanation: यह लोकोक्ति दिखावे या पाखंड के लिए है: मन में कुछ, बाहर कुछ। (Q88 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: 'लाख का घर राख होना' मुहावरे का अर्थ है:
questions.explanation: लाख का घर राख होना = धनी व्यक्ति का निर्धन हो जाना (सब कुछ नष्ट हो जाना)। (Q90 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-9.html

questions.text: If the freezing point of a gas at sea level is −435°F, its freezing point in °C is (approximately)
questions.textHi: यदि किसी गैस का जमाव बिन्दु समुद्र तल पर −435°F हो, तो °C में उसका जमाव बिन्दु (लगभग) होगा
questions.explanation: °C = (°F − 32) × 5/9 = (−435 − 32) × 5/9 ≈ −259.4°C. (Q91 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: For a circle, the value of π is
questions.textHi: वृत्त के संदर्भ में π का मान है-
questions.explanation: π = circumference ÷ diameter for every circle. (Q92 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: The difference of two complementary angles is 30°. The angles are
questions.textHi: दो पूरक कोणों का अंतर 30° है। कोण हैं :-
questions.explanation: x + y = 90 and x − y = 30 give 60° and 30°. (Q93 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: If 45 is added to half of a number, the result is triple the number. The number is
questions.textHi: यदि किसी संख्या के आधे में 45 जोड़ा जाए तो परिणाम उस संख्या का तिगुना हो जाता है। संख्या है
questions.explanation: x/2 + 45 = 3x gives 2.5x = 45, so x = 18. (Q94 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: A speed of 72 km/h expressed in metres/second is
questions.textHi: 72 किमी/घंटा की गति को मीटर/सेकंड में व्यक्त करने पर प्राप्त होता है
questions.explanation: 1 km/h = 1000/3600 m/s, so 72 km/h = (72 × 1000)/3600 = 20 m/s. (Q95 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: Which of the following has the largest value?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से किसका मूल्य सबसे बड़ा है?
questions.explanation: 32/0.05 = 640, larger than 64, 0.064 and 0.0064. (Q96 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: Two supplementary angles are in the ratio 1 : 2. The bigger angle is
questions.textHi: दो संपूरक कोण 1 : 2 के अनुपात में हैं, तो बड़ा कोण है
questions.explanation: x + 2x = 180°, so x = 60° and the bigger angle is 120°. (Q97 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: Suresh bought 20 kg of apples at Rs 50 per kg. 5% of the apples were found rotten. If he sells the rest at Rs 60 per kg, find his profit per cent.
questions.textHi: सुरेश ने 20 किग्रा सेब 50 रुपये प्रति किग्रा की दर से खरीदे। इनमें से 5% सेब सड़े हुए पाए गए। यदि वह बाकी सेब 60 रुपये प्रति किग्रा बेचता है, तो लाभ प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.explanation: CP = 20 × 50 = Rs 1000; 19 kg sold at Rs 60 = Rs 1140; profit = 140/1000 = 14%. (Q98 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: 25 ml out of 5 litres is equal to
questions.textHi: 5 लीटर का 25 मिली बराबर है :-
questions.explanation: 25 ml / 5000 ml × 100 = 0.5%. (Q99 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: A shopkeeper has 48 litres of oil. He sold 5/8 of the oil to one family and 3 litres to another family. How many litres must he add to the remaining oil to make it 20 litres?
questions.textHi: एक दुकानदार के पास 48 लीटर तेल है। उसने एक परिवार को 5/8 तेल और दूसरे परिवार को 3 लीटर तेल बेचा। शेष तेल में वह कितने लीटर तेल मिलाए कि वह 20 लीटर हो जाए?
questions.explanation: 48 − 5/8 × 48 = 18 litres; 18 − 3 = 15 litres; 20 − 15 = 5 litres to be added. (Q100 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-10.html

questions.text: The area of a semicircle of radius 4r is
questions.textHi: त्रिज्या 4r वाले अर्धवृत्त का क्षेत्रफल होगा
questions.explanation: Area = ½ π (4r)² = 8πr². (Q101 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-11.html

questions.text: The number 249636 is completely divisible by
questions.textHi: संख्या 249636 निम्न में से किससे पूर्णतया विभाज्य है?
questions.explanation: 249636 is even, its digit sum 30 is divisible by 3 and its last two digits 36 are divisible by 4 (but 30 is not divisible by 9). (Q102 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-11.html

questions.text: Reeta's income is 25% more than Sita's. By what per cent is Sita's income less than Reeta's?
questions.textHi: यदि रीता की आय सीता की आय से 25% अधिक हो, तो सीता की आय रीता की आय से कितने प्रतिशत कम है?
questions.explanation: If Sita = 100, Reeta = 125; Sita is 25/125 = 20% less. (Q103 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-11.html

questions.text: 1/8 of a number is equal to (2/5) ÷ (1/20). The number is
questions.explanation: (2/5) ÷ (1/20) = 8, so the number = 8 × 8 = 64. (Q104 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-11.html

questions.text: The simple interest on Rs 12000 at 10% per annum for one month is
questions.textHi: 10% वार्षिक की दर से ₹ 12000 पर एक महीने का साधारण ब्याज होगा
questions.explanation: SI = 12000 × 10/100 × 1/12 = Rs 100. (Q105 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-11.html

questions.text: 10 men or 12 women can complete a job in 10 days. In how many days will 5 men and 6 women together complete it?
questions.textHi: यदि 10 आदमी या 12 औरतें एक काम को 10 दिन में करते हैं, तो 5 आदमी और 6 औरतें मिलकर उस काम को कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगे?
questions.explanation: 10 men = 12 women, so 5 men = 6 women; 5 men + 6 women = 12 women, who need 10 days. (Q106 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-11.html

questions.text: The perimeter of a rectangle is 40 m. Its length is 4 m less than 5 times its breadth. The length is
questions.textHi: एक आयत का परिमाप 40 m है। इसकी लम्बाई, चौड़ाई के 5 गुने से 4 m कम है। लम्बाई है
questions.explanation: 2(l + b) = 40 and l = 5b − 4 give 6b − 4 = 20, b = 4 m, l = 16 m. (Q111 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: A car covers 120 km in 4 hours. By how much should its speed be increased to cover the same distance in 3 hours?
questions.textHi: एक कार 4 घंटे में 120 किमी की दूरी तय करती है। 3 घंटे में समान दूरी तय करने के लिए कार की गति कितनी बढ़ाई जानी चाहिए?
questions.explanation: Speed needed = 120/3 = 40 km/h versus 30 km/h now, an increase of 10 km/h. (Q112 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: The range of the data 6, 17, 18, 13, 21, 12, 4, 8 is
questions.explanation: Range = highest − lowest = 21 − 4 = 17. (Q113 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: Which of the following cannot be the third side of a triangle whose other two sides are 18 cm and 14 cm?
questions.textHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी उस त्रिभुज की तीसरी भुजा नहीं हो सकती जिसकी दो भुजाएँ 18 सेमी और 14 सेमी हैं?
questions.explanation: The third side must lie between 18 − 14 = 4 cm and 18 + 14 = 32 cm, so 3 cm is impossible. (Q114 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: 225% is equal to
questions.textHi: 225% बराबर है
questions.explanation: 225% = 225/100 = 9/4 = 9 : 4. (Q115 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: The smallest four-digit number divisible by 18, 32 and 24 is
questions.textHi: चार अंकों की सबसे छोटी संख्या जो 18, 32 और 24 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो, है
questions.explanation: LCM(18, 32, 24) = 288; the first four-digit multiple is 288 × 4 = 1152. (Q117 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: The LCM and HCF of two numbers are 280 and 14 respectively. If one number is 70, the other is
questions.textHi: दो संख्याओं का ल.स.प. तथा म.स.प. क्रमशः 280 व 14 है। यदि एक संख्या 70 हो, तो दूसरी संख्या होगी
questions.explanation: Other number = 280 × 14 ÷ 70 = 56. (Q118 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: If (13² − 5²)^(3/2) = 6³ × A, then the value of A is
questions.explanation: 13² − 5² = 144; 144^(3/2) = 12³ = 1728 = 216 × 8, so A = 8. (Q119 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: Which of the following is equal to 1?
questions.textHi: निम्न में से कौन-सा 1 के बराबर है?
questions.explanation: Any non-zero number to the power 0 is 1, so 2⁰ × 3⁰ × 4⁰ = 1 (the sum is 3 and the others are 0). (Q120 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-12.html

questions.text: The Salar Jung Museum is located in which city?
questions.textHi: सालार जंग म्यूजियम कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The Salar Jung Museum is in Hyderabad. (Q121 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: Child labour is dealt with in which Article of the Constitution of India?
questions.textHi: बाल श्रम का संबंध भारत के संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद से है?
questions.explanation: Article 24 prohibits employment of children below 14 in factories, mines and hazardous work. (Q122 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: The first mega Food Park of Himachal Pradesh was started in which of the following district?
questions.textHi: हिमाचल प्रदेश का पहला मेगा फूड पार्क निम्नलिखित में से किस जिले में शुरू किया गया था?
questions.explanation: HP's first Mega Food Park is at Singha, Haroli tehsil, Una district. (Q123 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: Which pass separates Lahaul from Spiti?
questions.textHi: निम्न में से कौन-सा दर्रा लाहौल और स्पीति को अलग करता है?
questions.explanation: Kunzum Pass (about 4,590 m) separates Lahaul from Spiti. (Q125 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: What is the name of the hills in Una district?
questions.textHi: ऊना जिले की पहाड़ियों का नाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: Una lies in the Shivalik hills (the Sola Singhi range is part of them). (Q126 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: Todar Mal was associated with
questions.textHi: टोडर मल किससे सम्बन्धित था?
questions.explanation: Raja Todar Mal was Akbar's finance minister and introduced the land revenue (Zabti/Dahsala) system. (Q127 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: Whom did Ashoka send to Sri Lanka to spread Buddhism?
questions.textHi: अशोक ने बौद्ध धर्म के प्रचार के लिए किसे श्री लंका भेजा था?
questions.explanation: Ashoka sent his son Mahendra and daughter Sanghamitra to Sri Lanka. (Q128 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: Which ruler of ancient India is depicted on his coins playing the lute (veena)?
questions.textHi: प्राचीन भारत के किस शासक को उसके सिक्कों पर वीणा बजाते हुए चित्रित किया गया है?
questions.explanation: Samudragupta's lyrist-type gold coins show him playing the veena. (Q129 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: The Battle of Buxar was fought in the year
questions.textHi: बक्सर का युद्ध लड़ा गया था वर्ष -
questions.explanation: The Battle of Buxar was fought in 1764. (Q130 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-13.html

questions.text: The number of non-permanent members of the United Nations Security Council is
questions.textHi: संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ सुरक्षा परिषद के अस्थाई सदस्यों की संख्या कितनी है?
questions.explanation: The UN Security Council has 5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members. (Q131 of the paper.) Source: https://hpallexam.blogspot.com/2022/03/hp-tet-jbt-nov-2020-part-14.html

questions.text: The term "Bull's Eye" is related to which game?
